_comment: Which YouTube channel belongs to which row of the attendance sheet.
`row` must equal the temple's label in column A of the tab, exactly. It is
matched case-insensitively and ignoring surrounding spaces, but nothing
cleverer than that: if someone renames a temple in the sheet the service
reports the mismatch in Slack rather than guessing a neighbouring row.
`tz` is an IANA zone and only decides the clock time shown in the cell —
the date column itself is UTC for every temple.
`patterns` here are added to the shared list below for that temple alone.

temples.note: No Garbha Mandir naming convention yet — will read Absent until one exists.
